title: Personal Sender Account Schedule: Lapsed Documents, Suspension Appeals and Closure Terms
content:
Four standing terms of the Personal Sender Account vary with the verification level: the grace allowed after a required document expires, the level the account moves down to when that grace runs out, the window for appealing a suspension, and whether the account may be closed while a personal transfer is still open.

| Level | Grace after a required document's expiry date before moving down a level (calendar days) | Level the account moves down to | Suspension appeal window (calendar days after the suspension) | Closure while any personal transfer is still open |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Starter | 0 | Paloma Starter | 30 | not allowed |
| Paloma Verified | 30 | Paloma Starter | 30 | not allowed |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 30 | Paloma Verified | 30 | not allowed |
| Paloma Enhanced | 30 | Paloma Verified Plus | 30 | not allowed |
| Paloma Premier | 45 | Paloma Enhanced | 45 | not allowed |
| Paloma Private Client | 60 | Paloma Premier | 60 | not allowed |

## Notes

- The move-down column names the level one step below each level; for Paloma Starter, which requires no document, it names Paloma Starter itself and the grace is 0.
- Closure while a personal transfer is still open is not allowed at any level.
- The appeal window is 30 calendar days at the four lower levels, 45 at Paloma Premier and 60 at Paloma Private Client.
